# Unit 1 — Greetings & pronouns
你|nǐ|you|你好！|Nǐ hǎo!|Hello!
好|hǎo|good; well|我很好。|Wǒ hěn hǎo.|I'm very well.
我|wǒ|I; me|我是学生。|Wǒ shì xuésheng.|I'm a student.
是|shì|to be|他是老师。|Tā shì lǎoshī.|He is a teacher.
很|hěn|very|今天很冷。|Jīntiān hěn lěng.|It's very cold today.
吗|ma|(question particle)|你好吗？|Nǐ hǎo ma?|How are you?
呢|ne|(follow-up question particle)|我很好，你呢？|Wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne?|I'm well, and you?
不|bù|not; no|我不是老师。|Wǒ bú shì lǎoshī.|I'm not a teacher.
也|yě|also; too|我也是学生。|Wǒ yě shì xuésheng.|I'm a student too.
您|nín|you (polite)|您好！|Nín hǎo!|Hello! (polite)
他|tā|he; him|他是我朋友。|Tā shì wǒ péngyou.|He is my friend.
她|tā|she; her|她是我妈妈。|Tā shì wǒ māma.|She is my mom.
它|tā|it|它是我的猫。|Tā shì wǒ de māo.|It's my cat.
们|men|(plural suffix)|老师们好！|Lǎoshīmen hǎo!|Hello, teachers!
我们|wǒmen|we; us|我们是同学。|Wǒmen shì tóngxué.|We are classmates.
你们|nǐmen|you (plural)|你们好！|Nǐmen hǎo!|Hello, everyone!
他们|tāmen|they (male/mixed)|他们是中国人。|Tāmen shì Zhōngguó rén.|They are Chinese.
她们|tāmen|they (female)|她们是姐姐和妹妹。|Tāmen shì jiějie hé mèimei.|They are older and younger sisters.
它们|tāmen|they (things/animals)|它们是我的狗。|Tāmen shì wǒ de gǒu.|They are my dogs.
大家|dàjiā|everyone|大家好！|Dàjiā hǎo!|Hello, everyone!
谢谢|xièxie|thank you|谢谢你！|Xièxie nǐ!|Thank you!
不客气|bú kèqi|you're welcome|不客气。|Bú kèqi.|You're welcome.
对不起|duìbuqǐ|sorry|对不起，我来晚了。|Duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le.|Sorry, I'm late.
没关系|méi guānxi|it doesn't matter|没关系。|Méi guānxi.|No problem.
再见|zàijiàn|goodbye|明天见！再见！|Míngtiān jiàn! Zàijiàn!|See you tomorrow! Bye!
请|qǐng|please; to invite|请坐。|Qǐng zuò.|Please sit.
请问|qǐngwèn|excuse me, may I ask|请问，你叫什么名字？|Qǐngwèn, nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?|Excuse me, what's your name?
喂|wéi|hello (on the phone)|喂，你好！|Wéi, nǐ hǎo!|Hello? (phone)
叫|jiào|to be called; to call|我叫王小明。|Wǒ jiào Wáng Xiǎomíng.|My name is Wang Xiaoming.
名字|míngzi|name|你叫什么名字？|Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?|What's your name?
什么|shénme|what|这是什么？|Zhè shì shénme?|What is this?
认识|rènshi|to know (a person)|认识你很高兴。|Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng.|Nice to meet you.
高兴|gāoxìng|happy; glad|我今天很高兴。|Wǒ jīntiān hěn gāoxìng.|I'm very happy today.
的|de|(possessive particle)|这是我的书。|Zhè shì wǒ de shū.|This is my book.
人|rén|person|他是中国人。|Tā shì Zhōngguó rén.|He is Chinese.
中国|Zhōngguó|China|我想去中国。|Wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó.|I want to go to China.
国|guó|country|你是哪国人？|Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?|Which country are you from?
朋友|péngyou|friend|他是我的好朋友。|Tā shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.|He is my good friend.
先生|xiānsheng|Mr.; sir; husband|王先生在家吗？|Wáng xiānsheng zài jiā ma?|Is Mr. Wang home?
女士|nǚshì|Ms.; lady|李女士是老师。|Lǐ nǚshì shì lǎoshī.|Ms. Li is a teacher.
# Unit 2 — Numbers & quantity
一|yī|one|我有一个哥哥。|Wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge.|I have one older brother.
二|èr|two|今天是二号。|Jīntiān shì èr hào.|Today is the 2nd.
三|sān|three|我有三本书。|Wǒ yǒu sān běn shū.|I have three books.
四|sì|four|他四岁。|Tā sì suì.|He is four.
五|wǔ|five|我们五点见。|Wǒmen wǔ diǎn jiàn.|See you at five.
六|liù|six|我家有六个人。|Wǒ jiā yǒu liù ge rén.|There are six people in my family.
七|qī|seven|一个星期有七天。|Yí ge xīngqī yǒu qī tiān.|A week has seven days.
八|bā|eight|我八点起床。|Wǒ bā diǎn qǐchuáng.|I get up at eight.
九|jiǔ|nine|现在九点。|Xiànzài jiǔ diǎn.|It's nine o'clock now.
十|shí|ten|这个十块钱。|Zhège shí kuài qián.|This is ten yuan.
零|líng|zero|我的电话号是零六八。|Wǒ de diànhuà hào shì líng liù bā.|My phone number is zero six eight.
百|bǎi|hundred|这件衣服一百块。|Zhè jiàn yīfu yìbǎi kuài.|This piece of clothing is 100 yuan.
千|qiān|thousand|这个手机三千块。|Zhège shǒujī sānqiān kuài.|This phone is 3,000 yuan.
两|liǎng|two (with measure words)|我有两个妹妹。|Wǒ yǒu liǎng ge mèimei.|I have two younger sisters.
半|bàn|half|现在八点半。|Xiànzài bā diǎn bàn.|It's 8:30 now.
一半|yíbàn|half|我吃了一半。|Wǒ chī le yíbàn.|I ate half.
第|dì|(ordinal prefix)|这是我第一次来中国。|Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó.|This is my first time in China.
几|jǐ|how many; a few|你家有几个人？|Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?|How many people are in your family?
多少|duōshao|how many; how much|这个多少钱？|Zhège duōshao qián?|How much is this?
多|duō|many; much|这里人很多。|Zhèlǐ rén hěn duō.|There are many people here.
少|shǎo|few; little|今天人很少。|Jīntiān rén hěn shǎo.|There are few people today.
个|gè|(general measure word)|我想买一个苹果。|Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge píngguǒ.|I want to buy an apple.
本|běn|(measure word for books)|我买了两本书。|Wǒ mǎi le liǎng běn shū.|I bought two books.
件|jiàn|(measure word for clothes, matters)|这件衣服很漂亮。|Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang.|This piece of clothing is very pretty.
口|kǒu|mouth; (measure word for family members)|我家有三口人。|Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.|There are three people in my family.
些|xiē|some|我想买些水果。|Wǒ xiǎng mǎi xiē shuǐguǒ.|I want to buy some fruit.
一些|yìxiē|some; a few|我有一些问题。|Wǒ yǒu yìxiē wèntí.|I have some questions.
有些|yǒuxiē|some|有些人喜欢喝茶。|Yǒuxiē rén xǐhuan hē chá.|Some people like drinking tea.
有的|yǒude|some (of)|有的人喜欢猫，有的人喜欢狗。|Yǒude rén xǐhuan māo, yǒude rén xǐhuan gǒu.|Some people like cats, some like dogs.
一点儿|yìdiǎnr|a little|我会说一点儿汉语。|Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr Hànyǔ.|I can speak a little Chinese.
有点儿|yǒudiǎnr|a bit; somewhat|今天有点儿冷。|Jīntiān yǒudiǎnr lěng.|It's a bit cold today.
岁|suì|years old|你几岁？|Nǐ jǐ suì?|How old are you?
钱|qián|money|我没有钱。|Wǒ méiyǒu qián.|I don't have money.
块|kuài|yuan (spoken); piece|一个苹果五块。|Yí ge píngguǒ wǔ kuài.|An apple is five yuan.
元|yuán|yuan (written)|这本书二十元。|Zhè běn shū èrshí yuán.|This book is 20 yuan.
# Unit 3 — Family & people
家|jiā|home; family|我在家。|Wǒ zài jiā.|I'm at home.
家人|jiārén|family member|我很爱我的家人。|Wǒ hěn ài wǒ de jiārén.|I love my family very much.
爸爸|bàba|dad|我爸爸是医生。|Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng.|My dad is a doctor.
妈妈|māma|mom|妈妈在做饭。|Māma zài zuò fàn.|Mom is cooking.
哥哥|gēge|older brother|我哥哥很高兴。|Wǒ gēge hěn gāoxìng.|My older brother is very happy.
姐姐|jiějie|older sister|我姐姐在公司工作。|Wǒ jiějie zài gōngsī gōngzuò.|My older sister works at a company.
弟弟|dìdi|younger brother|我弟弟六岁。|Wǒ dìdi liù suì.|My younger brother is six.
妹妹|mèimei|younger sister|我妹妹喜欢猫。|Wǒ mèimei xǐhuan māo.|My younger sister likes cats.
儿子|érzi|son|他儿子是大学生。|Tā érzi shì dàxuéshēng.|His son is a university student.
女儿|nǚ'ér|daughter|她女儿很漂亮。|Tā nǚ'ér hěn piàoliang.|Her daughter is very pretty.
孩子|háizi|child|你有孩子吗？|Nǐ yǒu háizi ma?|Do you have children?
小朋友|xiǎopéngyǒu|child; kid|小朋友，你好！|Xiǎopéngyǒu, nǐ hǎo!|Hi there, kid!
男|nán|male|他是男老师。|Tā shì nán lǎoshī.|He is a male teacher.
女|nǚ|female|我的老师是女的。|Wǒ de lǎoshī shì nǚ de.|My teacher is a woman.
男朋友|nánpéngyou|boyfriend|她有男朋友。|Tā yǒu nánpéngyou.|She has a boyfriend.
女朋友|nǚpéngyou|girlfriend|这是我女朋友。|Zhè shì wǒ nǚpéngyou.|This is my girlfriend.
老师|lǎoshī|teacher|老师，你好！|Lǎoshī, nǐ hǎo!|Hello, teacher!
学生|xuésheng|student|我是学生。|Wǒ shì xuésheng.|I'm a student.
同学|tóngxué|classmate|他是我的同学。|Tā shì wǒ de tóngxué.|He's my classmate.
医生|yīshēng|doctor|我想去看医生。|Wǒ xiǎng qù kàn yīshēng.|I want to see a doctor.
大学生|dàxuéshēng|university student|我哥哥是大学生。|Wǒ gēge shì dàxuéshēng.|My older brother is a university student.
中学生|zhōngxuéshēng|middle/high school student|她是中学生。|Tā shì zhōngxuéshēng.|She's a high school student.
小学生|xiǎoxuéshēng|elementary school student|我弟弟是小学生。|Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxuéshēng.|My younger brother is in elementary school.
狗|gǒu|dog|我家有一只狗。|Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī gǒu.|My family has a dog.
猫|māo|cat|我喜欢猫。|Wǒ xǐhuan māo.|I like cats.
只|zhī / zhǐ|(measure word for animals); only|我只有一只猫。|Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yì zhī māo.|I only have one cat.
